headline: Recommended final passage of R-26-054 to renew Pennichuck Corporation's $4 million line of credit with TD Bank, N.A. for three years
summary: The committee heard a report from Chief Financial Officer George Torres on renewing Pennichuck Corporation's $4 million working capital line of credit with TD Bank. The committee recommended final passage of resolution R-26-054 authorizing the renewal and extension of the line of credit.
decisions: Recommended final passage of R-26-054, authorizing Pennichuck Corporation to renew and extend its line of credit with TD Bank, N.A.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION BY ALDERMAN LOPEZ TO RECOMMEND FINAL PASSAGE ... MOTION CARRIED

plain_text:
PENNICHUCK WATER SPECIAL COMMITTEE 
 
AUGUST 31, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Pennichuck Water Special Committee was held Monday, August 31, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. in the Aldermanic 
Chamber. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 5 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman-at-Large Lori Wilshire, Alderman-at-
Large Michael B. O’Brien, Sr., Alderman Thomas Lopez, Alderman James Ravan, and Alderman Patricia Klee. 
 
Also in Attendance:   John Boisvert, Chief Executive Officer 
    George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 
      
 
PUBLIC COMMENT - None 
 
COMMUNICATIONS  
 
 From: John J. Boisvert, Chief Executive Officer of Pennichuck Corporation 
Re: Quarterly Report of the Sole Shareholder for the Quarter Ended March 31, 2026 
 
 
 
From: Office of Corporation Counsel 
Re: R-26-054 "Authorizing Pennichuck Corporation to renew and extend its line of credit with TD Bank, N.A."  
 
There being no objection, Chairman Klee accepted the communications and placed them on file. 
 
UNFINISHED BUSINESS – None  
 
NEW BUSINESS – RESOLUTIONS  
 
 R-26-054 
     Endorsers: Alderman Patricia Klee 
Alderman-at-Large Michael B. O’Brien, Sr. 
Alderman Richard A. Dowd 
Alderman-at-Large Lori Wilshire 
AUTHORIZING PENNICHUCK CORPORATION TO RENEW AND EXTEND ITS LINE OF CREDIT WITH TD BANK, 
N.A. 
 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN LOPEZ TO RECOMMEND FINAL PASSAGE 
 
ON THE QUESTION 
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Okay.  Are there any discussions and would Mr. Boisvert and Mr. Torres would you like to come up and kind of give us a 
brief. 
 
Alderman Wilshire 
 
How about those Red Sox?  They may get Mickey Gasper back. 
 
Unidentified Male Speaker 
 
That was a great game.  Great series. 
 
Unidentified Male Speaker 
 
I’m a Yankee fan.  Sorry, sorry.  I apologize.
Pennichuck – 08/31/2026                                                                                                                   Page 2 
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Give him a seat that falls down. 
 
Unidentified Male Speaker 
 
Don’t advertise that you’re a Yankee’s fan. 
 
Unidentified Male Speaker 
 
Oh, I’m sorry guys. 
 
Unidentified Male Speaker 
 
We grew up down there.  We have to (inaudible). 
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Alderman Clemons’ is as well so.  He’s not here. 
 
Unidentified Male Speaker 
 
Yeah, I’m a transplant so. 
 
Alderman Clemons 
 
No, he was born and raised here so he has no excuse but we love him so much.  So we forgive him.  Anyways, did you 
want to address the renewal on the extension on the line of credit with TD Bank. 
 
John Boisvert, Chief Executive Officer  
 
Sure, I’ll let George handle that one.  
 
George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer  
 
Are you sure you don’t want to do it? 
 
John Boisvert, Chief Executive Officer  
 
No, I’m okay.  You got this one.   
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Mr. Torres, thank you.  
 
George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 
 
Thank you and good evening.  So what you have before you is a term sheet from TD Bank which is as you stated earlier 
is for the renewal of our existing working capital line of credit at Penn. Corp.  It is a $4 million facility.  That facilit y has 
been in existence since 2014 in various amounts but currently it’s at $4 million.  It is a three year renewal which differs 
from the prior facility.  The existing facilities that we currently have now prior to this renewal were two year facilities.  In 
negotiation with TD, we’ve been able to extend that for three years now.  So that will require us to come in here less often.   
 
But essentially, it’s identical in all respective terms to the prior facility which this renews and essentially what it does is it 
backstops the subsidiaries under Penn. Corp., which contain P.W.W. and P.W.S. (Penn Water Service as well as 
Pennichuck Water Works) and it’s available for those subsidiaries when needed.  Because it sits at the corporate level, it 
doesn’t require a regulatory approval.  It just requires approval of our Board, and obviously this Committee, as well as the 
Board of Aldermen, and in its effect.  So it should go into effect at the end of September and it should carry us through the 
end of September of 2029.  As I mentioned before, it’s identical to the one it replaces right now or renews and I’m 
available for any specific questions that hopefully I can answer.
Pennichuck – 08/31/2026                                                                                                                   Page 3 
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Are there any questions?  Just to clarify when you say it’s the same, it’s the same rate and... 
 
George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 
 
So, it’s a floating rate.  So essentially it’s like any other line of credit like say a credit card.  It’s based on the SOFR rate , 
which is the standard rate plus 1.75%.  So whatever the stated SOFR rate is, you add 1 3/4 basis points or 1.75% and 
that’s effectively your rate.  So right now, that’s probably floating around I would say around 5 percentage points.  
Somewhere around there but that’s essentially – it moves with the market.  
 
Chairman Klee 
 
And just for the record also, this line of credit is something that’s extremely important so that you don’t have to run ... 
 
George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 
 
It is.  
 
Chairman Klee 
 
…around if there’s an emergency or a sudden need that ... 
 
George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 
 
It is.   
 
Chairman Klee 
 
…was unexpected.  
 
George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 
 
So as I mentioned before, it backstops all the subsidiaries.  So P.W.W. has a fixed asset l ine of credit – a $60 million 
facility, but that’s strictly for their capital.  This working capital makes itself available to Penn. Water Works , and as well as 
P.W.S., and Penn. Corp. for anything outside of capital – any operating expense, timing issues where hopefully if we don’t 
have sufficient operating cash at that moment, it automatically draws on this working capital line of credit , fills the 
operating account, and then automatically gets cleaned out when cash is available.  
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Thank you.  
 
George Torres, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer 
 
Yup.  
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Any questions?  Seeing none. 
 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
Chairman Klee 
 
Thank you so much. 
 
NEW BUSINESS – ORDINANCE - None 
 
GENERAL DISCUSSION - None
Pennichuck – 08/31/2026                                                                                                                   Page 4 
 
PUBLIC COMMENT - None 
 
REMARKS BY THE ALDERMEN 
 
Alderman Lopez 
 
I’m happy to be here. 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
  
MOTION BY ALDERMAN O’BRIEN TO ADJOURN 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
The meeting was declared closed at 7:06 p.m.     
 
     Alderman Thomas Lopez 
     Committee Clerk
